1  JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED: PASSED IN LAC NO. 150/2018  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:10142  MFA No. 204410 of 2023 BY THE LEARNED I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE,
KALABURAGI AND ETC.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM
ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 17.10.2022 in LAC No.150/2018.
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 93 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R. Kalliyanikutty1, the appeal is dismissed as time- AIR 1999 SC 1305 NC: 2024:KHC-K:10142 barred, without addressing the merits.
